summary: TASCK OS feature verification complete - all 13 features tested and passed. Verified: Landing page with 5 role selection cards, Staff portal Meetings and Contracts integration, Shared WalletPage across Creative/Super Creative/Brand portals, and Quick Action modals for all 5 roles.
passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with 5 role selection cards (Staff, Brand, Super Creative, Creative, Admin)
Staff portal: Meetings nav item visible in sidebar and navigates to /staff/meetings
Staff portal: Contracts nav item visible in sidebar and navigates to /staff/contracts
Staff Meetings page: Shows meeting list with tabs (All, Upcoming, Transcribed)
Staff Meetings page: Click meeting shows details with Transcript and AI-Generated Action Items
Staff Meetings page: New Meeting button opens modal with form fields
Staff Contracts page: Shows contract list with status badges (Pending Signatures, Fully Signed, Draft)
Staff Contracts page: Click contract shows details with Parties & Signature Status section
Staff Contracts page: Send to All Parties button opens send modal
Creative portal: Wallet page loads using shared WalletPage - shows 'My Wallet' label, VISA card, transactions
Super Creative portal: Wallet page loads using shared WalletPage - shows 'Team Wallet' label, MASTERCARD, escrow amounts
Brand portal: Wallet nav item visible in sidebar and navigates to /brand/wallet
Brand portal: Wallet page loads using shared WalletPage - shows 'Brand Wallet' label, VISA card, Total Spent metric
Staff Quick Action modal: 'New Deal' button opens modal with Create New Deal, Schedule Meeting, Create Contract, Post Opportunity
Brand Quick Action modal: 'New Campaign' button opens modal with Launch Campaign, Discover Talent, Request Approval
Super Creative Quick Action modal: 'New Project' button opens modal with Create Project, Post Opportunity, Fund Wallet
Creative Quick Action modal: 'New Application' button opens modal with Browse Opportunities, Update Portfolio, Withdraw Funds
Admin Quick Action modal: 'Quick Action' button opens modal with Manage Users, Review Disputes, Generate Report
Navigation works correctly between all pages without errors
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 portals fully functional with new features: Staff has Meetings and Contracts pages in sidebar. Shared WalletPage component works for Creative (My Wallet), Super Creative (Team Wallet), and Brand (Brand Wallet) with role-specific data and card designs. Quick Action modals work in all 5 portals with role-specific options. No bugs found.
